To solve this problem, we can use the following formula:

$$
\text{part}=\text{percentage}\times \text{whole}
$$

In our case, the whole is $200,$ and the percentage is $124%.$ 

**Method 1**

First, we convert the percentage to a decimal:

$$
124%=124÷100=1.24
$$

Applying our formula, we have:

$$
\begin{aligned}\text{part} & =\text{percentage}\times \text{whole} \\  & =124%\times 200 \\  & =1.24\times 200 \\  & =248\end{aligned}
$$

Therefore, $124%$ of $200$ is $248.$

**Method 2**

First, we convert the percentage to a fraction:

$$
124%=\frac{124}{100}=\frac{124÷4}{100÷4}=\frac{31}{25}
$$

Applying our formula, we have:

$$
\begin{aligned}\text{part} & =\text{percentage}\times \text{whole} \\  & =124%\times 200 \\  & =\frac{31}{25}\times 200 \\  & =31\times \frac{200}{25} \\  & =31\times 8 \\  & =248\end{aligned}
$$

Therefore, $124%$ of $200$ is $248.$
